微尘伴随着你的脚步，你几乎什么也没追上。 || align="center"|{{Item|2#5#5000|m}} |} === 页面交互信息 === {{语音表格|s|noAudio=1|char=3028}} {{语音表格 |name=1 |content=噢——请您别忘了拉普拉斯科算中心留下来的补给与勉励物，我想里面难免会有一些含保质期的东西……比如苦目糖？ |encontent=Oh, please don't forget to check on these supplies from Laplace. They may include things that expire… like Picrasma candy? }} {{语音表格 |name=2 |content=等等……APPLe某必须提醒您，有时深藏身与名并不是个好主意。 |encontent=Your humility becomes you, but I'm afraid this APPLe must insist you claim the reward you deserve. }} {{语音表格 |name=3 |content=佛罗伦萨是一块儿温和的好地方，每当APPLe沉静下来，就会想念那儿美不胜收的斜阳……那像酒一样令人迷醉。 |encontent=Florence is truly a fascinating place. When this APPLe quiets his mind, I am certain to miss the warm glow of its sunset ... like soaking in the finest wine. }} {{语音表格 |name=4 |content=能品尝到最古典的工艺所酿就的葡萄酒，APPLe某感到莫大荣幸——用船长的话说“就像喝到胡椒博士的第一人一般荣耀！” |encontent=It has been this APPLe's distinct pleasure to taste wine aged in a classic way. In Captain Regulus's own words, it's like "that first gulp of Dr. Papper!" }} {{语音表格 |name=5 |content=“Χαίρετε”！今天有个不错的天气不是吗……噢，您问这句耳熟的话是什么意思？莫桑女士跟APPLe某提过，这句话是雅典版的“吃了吗您”。 |encontent="Χαίρετε!" Isn't the weather lovely today ... Oh, you're wondering what that means? Ms. Moissan suggested it might mean something like "rejoice," but it is simply a common way to greet one another in Greek. }} {{语音表格 |name=6 |content=这将是一趟前所未有的旅途……您知道，APPLe某对能见到达·芬奇先生甚至更多的……名人，感到心潮澎湃。 |encontent=It would be a most unprecedented journey ... You know, this APPLe can't overemphasize his thrill at getting to meet Mr. Leonardo da Vinci and, of course other ... historical figures. }} {{语音表格 |name=7 |content=嗝儿……您要来尝一口苏芙比小姐复刻的雅典葡萄酒吗？虽然她说过里面没有哪怕一颗葡萄参与其中…… |encontent=*burp* Would you like to have a sip of Ms. Sotheby's Athenian Wine? Though she did mention something like "no grapes were used to make it" ... }} {{语音表格 |name=8 |content=您察觉到了APPLe某的这身新装束……我得承认，虽然一开始APPLe某对此装束有些抗拒，但在经历了一切后，如今对它有了些独特的感情…… |encontent=As you might have noticed, this APPLe is wearing something new. Though I was reluctant at first, everything we've been through has given it a meaning I didn't expect. It's starting to grow on me. }} {{语音表格 |name=9 |content=您想问APPLe某为什么能飘起来？APPLe某认为您更应该问重力国王为什么唯独赦免了APPLe某……不好意思，这确实太“冷”了。 |encontent=Why is this APPLe floating, you ask? Maybe the real question is—why did Mr. Gravity spare me from his gravitational sentence? …Ahem. My apologies.
